additional_info.subject: ID0475813-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/S3 300000004053] The device stuck on the 'Select charging point' screen CRM:03056000995
additional_info.body:
Hi Emre-abi, good morning.
The problem came after a power loss from the grid, we suddenly stop receiving logs and after a few minutes we receive the "INIT" to "CLOSE MAINBREAKER" and charger was working before.
This caused a docker to be corrupted.
We are trying to save this charger in order to avoid going to site to fix it.
If we are not able to fix it, then we need to go to charger and flash the CFAST.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0475813-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/S3 300000004053] The device stuck on the 'Select charging point' screen CRM:03056000995
additional_info.body:
Hi Emre-abi,
The problem has been resolved remotely. I would suggest to update to v8.1.4 as soon as possible to make sure these errors do not happen again.
I will close the ticket since it has been resolved.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
